spec.kitLine: After 5 normal attacks; all allies ATK ▲
spec.assertion: buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 5.46 reaching 5 distinct targetSlugs; RED under the self-scoped counterfactual (1 target + lower team totals) and under a caster-scaled stat (which flat-resolves and never emits 5.46). Trigger identity proved by dropping the count threshold to 1: applications must more than double, which is a no-op if the driver keyed it to interval/passive/burstCast. Round-vs-pellet counting bounded by per-ally application rate (SG hitsPerShot 10 would inflate ~10x).

Collapsing durationSec to 1 must strictly lower team totals — poli's 9-round magazine plus ~1.85s reload means a 1s window cannot bridge a reload, so the 10s window is load-bearing. Extending the window is NOT used as the discriminator because the refire cadence already saturates 10s uptime.

Structural: a passive (battle-start), self-targeted shield effect with maxHpPct 100 and durationSec 10. Discriminates the 40%-burst-shield magnitude being reused, an allies mis-scope, a missing duration, or a silent drop. No behavioural assertion exists because the engine emits no shield event and the control comp holds no shielded-trigger consumer.

buffApply stat 'defPct' value 23.51 with exactly 3 distinct targets and 8–10 activation groups over 180s — RED under an all-allies target set (5) and under a 10s interval (~18 groups). Plus an inertness assertion: stripping defPct leaves totals byte-identical, catching any wiring of DEF into a damage path.

spec.kitLine: self and 2 allies with the lowest HP
spec.assertion: Structural target kind 'alliesLowestHp' count 3 with an interval-20s trigger. Discriminates a positional selfAndAdjacent or an alliesTopAtk mis-read, both of which would resolve the same 3 slots at scope lock and be invisible to totals.
it.skip — no HP pool / no incoming boss damage at scope lock. Enforced non-silently: unmodeled.skill2 must be non-empty.

spec.disposition: FIX-RISK (payload asserted, trigger is a GAP)
spec.assertion: Structural: a heal effect with ticks 5 and intervalSec 1 — five separate recovery emissions, not one instant heal. This is the cross-unit tandem channel (crown consumes recovery), so an under-ticked heal under-refreshes a teammate's on-recovery kit. Delta-based behavioural proof was rejected as a discriminator because helm (also in the fixture) heals crown too and would mask the signal.

it.skip — no shield-expiry/status-end trigger primitive exists. The badge ends at t=10s OR early when the burst removes it, whichever is first; any encoding (interval / burstCast / passive) is an ⚑ approximation.

buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 44.55 to 5 distinct targets, and — the key claim — the buff lands BEFORE the first fullBurstStart in the event stream, since a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens. Re-keying to fullBurstEnter flips that ordering (buff index > fullBurstStart index), which is the assertion's RED. Ordering is used instead of counts because poli is a Burst II sharing the tier with crown, so a count comparison could be vacuous. A whole-picture guard also caps per-ally applications at the Full Burst count.
Structural: a burst shield effect with maxHpPct 40 and durationSec 10, distinct from the 100% self badge — catches the two shields being merged or one magnitude overwriting the other.

it.skip — defensive payload with no primitive, and shield REMOVAL has no primitive at all. Enforced non-silently: either a burst block carries requiresShielded (the closest gate for 'when in Police Badge status') or unmodeled.burst is non-empty.
No flatDamage / dot / storedHit / stackedNuke / weaponSwap effect anywhere in the override. Poli's kit contains zero damage lines, so any such effect is a fudge rather than a modeled mechanic.

fixtures: controlComp('poli', true) — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / poli / helm (B3), boss Fire, focus poli. helm is KEPT: poli is Burst II, and without a Burst III the team makes zero Full Bursts, which would make every burst-window assertion vacuous. helm=false was rejected for exactly that reason, at the cost of helm's heals confounding any recovery-delta probe — so poli's heal is asserted structurally instead. Six hoisted 180s runs: baseline plus five counterfactuals (skill1 ATK self-scoped, skill1 window 1s, skill1 count threshold 1, burst ATK re-keyed to fullBurstEnter, defPct stripped). Deterministic, no seed. NOTE: I had no tool access in this run, so the two artifact files could not be written to disk — scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/poli.test.ts is the `testSource` field verbatim and scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/poli.test-spec.json is this JSON object.
gaps: skill2 'Activates when Police Badge ends' — no shield-expiry/status-end trigger primitive; the badge ends at t=10s or early on burst removal, so any trigger choice is an ⚑ approximation (it.skip on trigger identity; the heal payload is still asserted structurally).
skill2 'Equally shares damage taken for 10 sec' — no HP pool and no incoming boss damage at scope lock (it.skip; must appear in unmodeled.skill2).

burst 'Gains Indomitability for 5 sec. Removes Police Badge.' — defensive payload with no primitive, and no shield-removal primitive exists (it.skip; must be gated via requiresShielded or recorded in unmodeled.burst).

Both shields (100% self badge, 40% shared) are structural-only: the engine emits no shield event kind and the control comp contains no shielded-trigger consumer, so magnitude/duration/target are asserted on the encoding rather than on behaviour.
DEF ▲23.51% is offensively inert in v1 — asserted as emitted-and-inert rather than damage-moving.

The heal→recovery tandem effect on crown could not be asserted as a damage delta because helm also heals in this fixture; a helm-free comp would isolate it but would remove the only Burst III and kill all Full Bursts.
